textAdd.text: For me, every project is not just a set of code, but a story about how an idea turns into a working product. I try to have logic behind the interfaces, and user—friendliness behind the logic.

aboutText.first: Four years ago, I tried my hand at web development for the first time at university. Honestly, at that time I thought I would go to game dev, but the code for websites suddenly tightened
aboutText.second:
Since then, I've been expanding my horizons: from the first simple pages,
 I've moved on to a full-fledged workbench, trying different technologies and approaches to
 creating interfaces.
aboutText.third:
I'm currently studying at my second university, testing new techniques and frameworks, 
 and constantly looking for fresh ways to make the web faster, more convenient, and more beautiful

tabs.languages:
These languages became the basis of my stack. I use them to create interfaces, write logic, and try different approaches to development. 

 I prefer to type the data directly, which makes the application better and minimizes the risk of errors.
tabs.frontend:
I build the user-facing part of applications, creating interfaces that are both functional and visually appealing.

 I enjoy working with components, managing state, and experimenting with different frameworks to improve user experience. Writing clean, typed code helps me prevent errors and keep projects maintainable.
